summary: This Form 6-K filed May 1, 2026 reports the appointment of Brian Ma as Acting Chief Financial Officer of Asia Pacific Wire & Cable Corporation Ltd, effective April 29, 2026, replacing Ben Lee who departed effective April 30, 2026. The filing includes a press release announcing the change, which is not part of a routine meeting or proxy circular. No financial terms, deal terms, or external advisors are mentioned. The change appears orderly with a transition plan. Watch for any subsequent filings related to permanent CFO appointment or strategic shifts.
